curl -k -I "https://vpn.contoso.example/"

# Конфиги

curl -k -i "https://vpn.contoso.example/.git/config"
curl -k -i "https://vpn.contoso.example/.env"
curl -k -i "https://vpn.contoso.example/config.php"
curl -k -i "https://vpn.contoso.example/web.config"
curl -k -i "https://vpn.contoso.example/backup.zip"

curl -k -i "https://vpn.contoso.example/admin"
curl -k -i "https://vpn.contoso.example/api/"

grep -oE '[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}' main.js | sort -u

  -w /usr/share/wordlists/seclists/Discovery/Web-Content/api/api-endpoints.txt \

curl -k -i -X OPTIONS -H "Origin: https://evil.com" -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: GET" "https://vpn.contoso.example/" | grep -i "access-control"
